interface.signature: def minimumSwap(s1: str, s2: str) -> int

preconditions.description: The lengths of s1 and s2 are equal.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'xy' for c in s1)
preconditions.description: All characters in s1 are either 'x' or 'y'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'xy' for c in s2)
preconditions.description: All characters in s2 are either 'x' or 'y'.

postconditions.description: The return value is either a non-negative integer or -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if (sum(1 for i in range(len(s1)) if s1[i] != s2[i]) % 2 != 0) else True
postconditions.description: If the number of mismatched positions is odd, return -1; otherwise, return a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(s1)) if s1[i] != s2[i]) // 2 + (sum(1 for i in range(len(s1)) if s1[i] != s2[i]) % 2)
postconditions.description: The return value is the minimum number of swaps required to make s1 and s2 equal.
